general.title: General Settings
general.startupDesc: Automatically launch the app when you sign in
general.analyticsDesc: Help improve Holdem by sharing anonymous usage data

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Customize how you interact with the app
shortcuts.escToCancel: Press a key combination, or Esc to cancel
shortcuts.needsModifier: Add Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win. Only F1–F24 work on their own.

dragDrop.dragToCopy: Drag files out to copy them
dragDrop.shiftToMove: Hold Shift while dropping to move files

mouse.title: Mouse Monitor
mouse.whitelistDesc: Shaking opens the shelf only while one of these apps is in front. Accepts process names (e.g. brave, brave.exe), case-insensitive. Leave the list empty to allow every app.

footer.hotkeyFailed: Settings saved, but the hotkey couldn't be registered
footer.autostartFailed: Settings saved, but the startup setting couldn't be changed

consent.title: Help us improve Holdem
consent.description: We'd like to collect anonymous usage data to improve your experience
consent.changeLater: You can change this at any time in Settings.
consent.summonTip: To bring the shelf back after hiding it, shake the mouse left and right while dragging a file, or set a hotkey in Settings.

updater.title: Software Updates
updater.downloadError: Failed to download and install update: {{error}}
updater.restartWarning: Holdem will restart to finish the update. Files on the shelf will be cleared.
